independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG1 scope. The F-DG1-232 fix (apps/web/e2e/journeys.spec.ts) was authored by frontend-ux-engineer, not by me; I raised the finding and here verify it as its originating reviewer. My only candidate-tree contributions are the test-first acceptance suites under tests/qa/** and e2e/** (permitted qa scope) and earlier-round evidence. The standalone reproduction shows the cause: ERR_PNPM_META_FETCH_FAIL GET https://registry.npmjs.org/is-number, ECONNREFUSED via the proxy. `create` resolves metadata from the live registry even though the tarball is in the store. This is exactly the residual D-057. All verifiable offline acceptance checks pass. Per the assignment and D-057 this is recorded as a PASS of the offline surface, not as BLOCKED; the live effect is not claimed.
